title: Restore owner-221 stock before the original chart-635 cutoff
body:
## Result

Move the four-instruction block for native 3406 (112→630) immediately after 3408 in the exact native rebind from #8017. That block only supplies the eventual owner 216, so the old chart-268 values and all 63 former 3410 readers stay exact. Owner 221’s four chart-635 receipts are available at 10118, 10142, 10154 and **19906**, before the original final receipt at **19907**. The output is assembled later. Both complete 680-row orientations pass, with owner 679 exact in each and identical paid grades. The retimed word gzip SHA-256 is `6073e796eacaf9cdb6e282752dc61c1db0e1baf7e2b734369b0652a781ba9603`.

## Caller obstruction and price

An independent source and literal audit rules out all **111** fixed-body reassignments at main port 17. The moved head is zero-dimensional, each available body has rank seven, and the original contact requires rank eight. The original head/body pair is the positive control. Retiming leaves the native rebind’s price unchanged. Even the hypothetical 36-fold productive credit leaves a binary margin about −0.07064423157 at κ = 0.00388. The separate unchanged rational margin is +0.13897452233. The altered port geometry, its actual signed outer price, finite application and owned erasure remain open. No new κ is asserted.

## Replay

Archive SHA-256 `cd0a58d5fe38e5674811e1b8d2fc0e321d0a701f8e99f3a39703721fc4f4b05f`. Fresh extraction passed `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`, `python3 -I -B verify_clock.py`, `python3 -I -B verify_owner17.py` and a second manifest check. An independent review also checked the receipt lifetimes and the later actual output swap, so 19906 measures stock availability.

## Prior work and open next questions

#8017 `6e090c180ad5c8c9a3ed50e94737fd2be04adf54` gives the complete original rebind. That tape keeps the relative owner-221 ordering, with a numeric final receipt at 19910. This follow-up strengthens the timing to the original numeric cutoff. #8019 `1cfbd53554154a3bb0b18b8ee607bb6c8ceaa37d` uses the separate fixed-endpoint approach. The next test is a genuinely funded rank-eight binding that preserves the exact retimed tape, or a distinct native construction that keeps the original one-dimensional head.
